correctness.rationale: Multiplicativity gives the stated local ratio \(\rho_p(a)\). For each fixed valuation vector on \(P=\{2,3,5,7,11,13\}\), the tail-squarefree condition has the displayed Euler-product density. The cylinders are disjoint, and tail primes at exponent one have local ratio greater than one, so every core with ratio at least one contributes except finitely many equality-core integers with empty tail. An independent exact replay of the inspected `verify_density.py` enumerated all \(6^6=46656\) vectors, found 17230 good and five equality vectors, and reproduced the exact coefficient \(6097572635664749695003/819750822146736480000\), giving \(0.753659844064288\ldots\) after division by \(\pi^2\).
residual_risks: The finite cylinder family is sufficient only; the exact density and optimal lower bound are not determined.
